hardware: 2x RTX 4090, 24564 MiB each, previously idle during runs

bugs_found.dataparallel_device_mismatch: easyocr wraps the recogniser in DataParallel whose device_ids start at cuda:0, so gpu='cuda:1' left weights and wrapper on different devices and 16 of 20 figures failed outright. Fixed by pinning CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES per worker so the chosen card is the only one visible.
bugs_found.allocator_retention: OCR activations stayed cached to the end of each figure; 4 workers per GPU exhausted 23.5 GiB. Fixed by releasing the cache once Stage 0 returns; peak fell from 23.4 GiB to 3.9 GiB per card.

equivalence_vs_cpu.roadmap_test: same label count, same texts, boxes within 2 px on 20 figures
equivalence_vs_cpu.verdict: The strict label-set test FAILS (16/20, 15/20). Float differences in CNN detection move borderline glyphs. No figure changes status or acceptance, and the text differences are single borderline readings that look neutral to favourable for GPU: on EP2730496B1 the CPU read '8' where the GPU read '68', and on EP2000273B1 the GPU found a '4' the CPU missed. Adopted with the deviation recorded rather than claimed as equivalent.
equivalence_vs_cpu.corpus_projection: 78k figures at 33.3 s and 6 workers is roughly 5 days, against about 20 days on CPU

identities.note: _behavior() ignores device placement so both are canonical, while effective_config_sha256 still distinguishes them in every record
